title: Application Programmer
description:
Genesis10 is currently seeking a Senior Oracle Database Developer for a hybrid position with a Global Financial Institution located in Charlotte, NC. This is a 12+ month contract opportunity requiring a minimum of 3 days per week onsite.

We are seeking a Senior Oracle Database Developer with strong experience in global banking data to design, develop, and optimize end-to-end analytical data objects on the Oracle database platform. This role is responsible for building analytics-ready structures from staging and ingestion layers through cleansed, conformed models, culminating in high-performing analytical views and reporting objects. These outputs will power web dashboards, enterprise reporting, and AI/ML-enabled tools, making reliability, performance, and governance critical.

Responsibilities:

  • Build trusted analytical objects end-to-end from raw/staged datasets through reporting-ready views
  • Deliver high-quality data that reduces downstream defects and improves report credibility
  • Produce fast, scalable database objects that meet dashboard SLAs and AI tool requirements
  • Demonstrate strong ownership by identifying issues, proposing improvements, and driving them to closure
  • Improve data quality, consistency, and lineage across the Oracle platform

Requirements:

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience as an Oracle Database Developer or Data Developer
  • Expert-level Oracle SQL and PL/SQL (complex joins, window functions, CTEs, performance tuning)
  • Strong experience building analytics/reporting layers (views, materialized views, aggregates, reporting schemas)
  • Proven ability to work with large-scale enterprise data, preferably in financial services or global banking
  • Strong understanding of data modeling and database design concepts (dimensional modeling, relational modeling)
  • Experience improving data quality and implementing repeatable validation frameworks
  • Ability to interpret complex schemas quickly and propose restructure or redesign approaches
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across data pipelines and database objects; ability to perform root-cause analysis
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical designs to technical and non-technical stakeholders

Desired skills:

  • Experience in Treasury, Payments, Risk, Finance, Markets, Client, or Regulatory banking domains
  • Experience with Oracle advanced features: partitioning, parallel query, materialized view refresh strategies, advanced indexing
  • Familiarity with enterprise governance concepts: data lineage, metadata management, reference data, master data
  • Experience supporting downstream consumers such as BI/Web dashboards (Power BI/Tableau) and AI/ML pipelines
  • Exposure to ETL/ELT concepts
  • Experience working in an Agile delivery environment with Jira/Confluence
  • Experience with RAG and LLM is a plus

Genesis10 is currently seeking an AI Engineer - Hybrid position with a Global Financial Institution located in Charlotte, NC. This is a 12+ month contract opportunity.

This role is centered on designing, developing, and deploying advanced AI/ML systems, building next-generation agentic AI solutions powered by retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Python-based AI development, modern orchestration frameworks like LangGraph, and a strong background in Model Risk Management (MRM) to ensure systems are governed, explainable, and trustworthy. This position requires a minimum of 3 days per week onsite.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop production-grade Python APIs and services
  • Deploy and operate applications on OpenShift
  • Partner with AI/ML engineers to productionize model capabilities into usable backend services
  • Remediate vulnerabilities in Python libraries, container images, and OpenShift deployment configurations
  • Design and implement advanced RAG pipelines using vector databases, embeddings, knowledge graphs, and hybrid retrieval strategies
  • Develop agentic AI systems using LangGraph, enabling dynamic task planning, reasoning, tool orchestration, and multi-agent workflows
  • Integrate Model Context Protocol (MCP) for standardized context sharing, tool interoperability, and scalable agent communication
  • Design memory systems and contextual state management for agent continuity and long-running workflows
  • Implement evaluation pipelines, prompt engineering strategies, and guardrails to ensure performance, safety, and reliability
  • Apply Model Risk Management (MRM) practices across the AI lifecycle, including model validation, explainability, bias detection, monitoring, and documentation

Requirements:

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field
  • Strong proficiency in Python programming, with experience building scalable AI/ML systems
  • Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks, particularly LangGraph, and emerging standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP)
  • Strong experience designing and implementing advanced RAG architectures, including Graph RAG
  • Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and LlamaIndex
  • Proven experience deploying LLM-powered production systems
  • Strong experience with Python ML/AI frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Scikit-learn
  • Hands-on experience with vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, Azure AI Search) and semantic retrieval systems
  • Deep understanding of agent orchestration patterns, including planning, reflection, tool usage, and multi-agent collaboration
  • Strong understanding of LLMOps/MLOps, including CI/CD, observability, monitoring, and performance optimization
  • Working knowledge of Model Risk Management (MRM) frameworks including governance, validation, and lifecycle controls
  • Familiarity with AI safety and alignment techniques, including guardrails and bias mitigation
  • Proficiency with development tools such as GitHub, VS Code, and JIRA

Desired skills:

  • Experience working in an Agile development methodology
  • Experience with RAG and LLM

title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
description:
Genesis10 is currently seeking a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) for a contract position with a Global Financial Institution located in Pennington, NJ. This is a 12+ month contract opportunity.

We are seeking a highly technical SDET to join our engineering team. You will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining automated testing frameworks that ensure our products remain robust as we scale. You will act as a bridge between development and operations, embedding "quality-by-design" into our CI/CD pipelines. The ideal candidate loves writing code to solve testing challenges and is passionate about building scalable, high-performance software.

Responsibilities:

  • Framework Architecture: Design and develop modular, scalable, and reusable test automation frameworks from the ground up using industry-standard tools (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or Appium)
  • Automation Development: Write production-quality code to automate end-to-end, integration, and performance tests, ensuring high test coverage across the stack
  • Pipeline Integration: Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) to enable continuous testing and rapid feedback
  • Performance & Load Testing: Proactively identify performance bottlenecks by designing and executing load and stress tests for microservices and APIs
  • White-Box Testing: Conduct deep-dive analysis by inspecting application logs, database queries, and system architectures to identify root causes of failures
  • Shift-Left Quality: Collaborate with software developers during the design phase to identify potential edge cases and promote testable code architectures
  • Infrastructure Management: Manage test environments, including containerized setups (Docker/Kubernetes), to ensure stable, isolated testing conditions

Requirements:

  • 4+ years of experience in software development and/or automated testing
  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language such as Python, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Strong experience with automation frameworks and libraries (e.g., PyTest, TestNG, Selenium, Playwright)
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Hands-on experience testing RESTful APIs using tools like Postman, RestAssured, or similar libraries
  • Ability to write complex SQL queries for data verification and setup
  • A strong "developer mindset"—you view testing as a software engineering problem to be solved with code, not just a series of manual steps
